narrative.scqa_md:
This file is the SOLE input for STEP 3 (report writing) Pentegra Retirement Services scores 2.31/5.0 (level 2 — Developing maturity) across 709 capability, supported by 47 evidence items (25.5% T1/T2 coverage). The assessment reveals a bifurcated digital profile: a modern Salesforce 5-cloud CRM platform (P4C3=3.24, implemented by Zennify per E-026/E-027) coexists with critical gaps in analytics (=1.28), data governance (=2.0), and digital marketing (=2.14). Three defining patterns emerge: 1. Bifurcated Digital Profile: The Salesforce 5-cloud implementation (FSC, SFMC, Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, Sales Cloud — E-026/E-027) modernized Pentegra's front-office. Experience Cloud delivers <24hr digital onboarding with DocuSign e-signature (E-026). Yet the back-office remains on an on-prem data warehouse (E-011) with zero BI/analytics tools (E-019), no integration platform (E-011), and legacy systems (Datair, ftwilliam.com — E-027). 2. Settlement Overhang: The $48.5M ERISA fiduciary breach settlement (E-005, E-023) — final approval December 2025 — caps Governance (2.73), Op Risk (2.6), and Compliance (2.86) at level 3.0 via S2 severity classification. CEFEX certification renewed January 2026 (E-005) and two cybersecurity-experienced board members added July 2024 (E-035: Yonesy Núñez, Gregory Wilson NACD.DC) demonstrate remediation intent. 3. Outsourced Capability Dependency: The Empower partnership (E-040) provides participant portal, mobile app, and Lifetime Income Score — but Pentegra owns none of this infrastructure. This creates single-vendor TPRM risk and means / scores partially reflect 3rd-party capability, not Pentegra-owned maturity. Pentegra trails the 4-peer median across 16 of 17 categories. The only near-parity or lead is in Onboarding (2.6 vs median 3.5, gap -0.90). Largest Gaps (vs peer median):
- Analytics & AI: 1.28 vs 3.0 (gap = -1.72). WHY: Pentegra has on-prem DW only (E-011), zero BI/analytics platforms (E-019). Peers: BPAS uses Snowflake+Power BI+Hadoop; FuturePlan uses Oracle DW+Snowflake+Power BI; TRA uses Adobe Analytics. - Data Governance: 2.0 vs 3.0 (gap = -1.00). WHY: No CDO (validated via E-061, Explorium — CTO Sprague oversees IT/InfoSec, not data), no data catalog, no data lineage. Salesforce is system of record but no enterprise data governance framework. - ESG: 1.16 vs 2.25 (gap = -1.09). WHY: No ESG reporting, sustainability metrics, or green finance products. Non-profit mission provides social alignment but no formal ESG framework. - Digital Marketing: 2.14 vs 3.0 (gap = -0.86). WHY: 1,139 monthly website visitors (E-019) is critically low for a national provider. Marketing stack fragmented: SharpSpring + SendGrid + Brevo coexist alongside deployed SFMC (E-011, E-019, E-026). - Personalization: 1.99 vs 2.75 (gap = -0.76). WHY: FSC client 360 deployed (E-026) but no AI personalization, no recommendation engine. Empower Lifetime Income Score (E-040) is 3rd-party, not Pentegra-owned. - Resilience & TPRM: 2.03 vs 3.0 (gap = -0.97). WHY: Empower dependency (E-040) is single-vendor risk. No BCP/DR evidence. AWS+Azure multi-cloud (E-011) but no orchestration. Where Pentegra Leads or Matches:
- Tech Architecture: 3.24 vs 3.25 (gap = -0.01). Salesforce 5-cloud + Copado DevOps (E-026/E-027) + CTO Sprague (E-061, Morgan Stanley pedigree) positions Pentegra competitively. - Onboarding: 2.6 vs 3.25 (gap = -0.65).

Experience Cloud <24hr onboarding (E-026) + DocuSign + Empower participant portal (E-040). - Compliance: 2.86 vs 3.0 (gap = -0.14). 80+ year fiduciary legacy + CEFEX (E-005). Capped at level 3.0 by settlement. Zennify has 10 recommendations mapped to 10 of 12 solution portfolio items. Priority sequencing: Wave 1 — Quick Wins (activate deployed assets):
-: Marketing Cloud consolidation (E-019: 1,139 visitors, E-011: SharpSpring/SendGrid/Brevo fragmentation). SFMC already deployed — this is activation, not net-new. -: Shield activation (E-005: $48.5M settlement, E-011: no SOC2/ISO27001). Zero infrastructure change. Post-settlement compliance hardening. -: Digital Strategy Workshop (E-026/E-027: tactical SF investment without published strategy, E-061: CTO ready for strategic alignment). -: Slack (E-010: Indeed 3.2 culture rating, E-019: 14 locations distributed workforce). Wave 2 — Data & Integration Foundation:
-: Data Cloud (E-011: on-prem DW only, E-019: zero BI tools). Replaces on-prem DW, enables ++. Foundation for everything else. -: MuleSoft (E-011: zero integration layer, E-026/E-027: Acumatica/Empower/Datair point-to-point). Greenfield opportunity. -: Agentforce (E-011: zero AI, E-026: Service Cloud deployed). 4-category lift. Depends on. -: CRM Analytics (E-011: zero BI). Embedded analytics in SF. Depends on. -: Experience Cloud expansion (E-026: <24hr onboarding exists, extend to advisor/sponsor self-service). Wave 3 — Governance:
-: GRC (E-005: settlement, E-023: prohibited transactions). ERISA compliance automation. Severity cap limits near-term lift. D. connected Unlocks 1. Data Cloud (/) → Personalization: XP-004 triggered because =2.0 < 2.5. Fixing data governance unlocks personalization ceiling. Data Cloud is the keystone. 2. Analytics → Automation → Servicing: Agentforce requires data to power AI servicing. Without analytics infrastructure, AI-powered case deflection and personalization cannot function. 3.

Settlement Cap Expiration → Governance/Compliance: // capped at level 3.0 regardless of investment. Cap expires when settlement ages beyond 24 months (post-December 2027). GRC builds toward post-cap maturity. 4. CTO as Executive Sponsor: Peter Sprague (E-061) — SVP IT & CTO, ex-Morgan Stanley ED — is the natural executive sponsor for Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and Agentforce. His technology leadership team (4 named members) provides governance capacity. E. Key Data Points for Report Sections Cover Page
- Entity: Pentegra Retirement Services
- Overall: 2.31/5.0 (level 2 — Developing)
- Evidence: 47 items | 709 subcaps | 25.5% T1/T2
- Assessment ID: DMA-ASM-PENT-20260317-0001
- Evidence Mode: RESEARCH_HANDOFF (PUBLIC)
- Date: 2026-03-17 SCQA Elements
- SITUATION: Pentegra, founded 1943 by FHLB system, is a $16B AUA non-profit retirement plan administrator (E-019) serving 50K+ plans and 1M+ participants (E-019) across 14 US locations. Client-owned governance (board of client CEOs). CEO Eric Wietsma (FSA, ex-MassMutual) since April 2023 (E-010). CTO Peter Sprague (SVP IT, ex-Morgan Stanley) leads 4-person tech team (E-061). - COMPLICATION: Despite a modern Salesforce 5-cloud platform (P4C3=3.24, E-026/E-027), Pentegra faces a $48.5M ERISA settlement (E-005/E-023), an analytics void (=1.28, -1.72 vs peers), and marketing dysfunction (P2C1=2.14, 1,139 monthly visitors — E-019). Overall score of 2.31 places Pentegra in level 2 (Developing), approximately 0.5 points below the peer median. - QUESTION: How can Pentegra leverage its existing Salesforce investment and fiduciary expertise to close the analytics, marketing, and compliance gaps while maintaining its onboarding advantage? - ANSWER: A three-wave transformation — activating deployed SFMC/Shield assets, then building a Data Cloud+MuleSoft+Agentforce foundation, then automating ERISA compliance via GRC — can advance Pentegra from level 2 (Developing, 2.31) to approximately level 3 (Established, 3.0-3.2), directly addressing the 3 critical and 7 high-priority gaps. Pillar Data for Deep Dives
- P1 (2.3): CTO Sprague validates tech leadership (E-061). $48.5M settlement caps at 3.0 (E-005). No published digital strategy (E-026/E-027 show tactical, not strategic SF investment). ESG void (=1.16). Indeed 3.7 overall / 2.9 job security (E-010). - P2 (2.31): Onboarding strength via Experience Cloud <24hr (E-026). 1,139 visitors critically low (E-019). SFMC underutilized alongside SharpSpring/SendGrid/Brevo (E-011). Empower provides participant portal but Pentegra-owned personalization absent (E-040). Service Cloud deployed with CTI (E-026) but no chatbot/AI. - P3 (2.45): CEFEX renewed (E-005) but settlement caps / at 3.0. No RPA — peers use UiPath (TRA), WinAutomation (BPAS). Copado CI/CD covers DevOps (E-027) but not business process automation. Empower dependency = TPRM risk (E-040). Legacy Datair/ftwilliam (E-027). - P4 (2.2): Tech architecture is competitive strength (P4C3=3.24, SF 5-cloud + Copado — E-026/E-027). Analytics is largest gap (P4C2=1.28, on-prem DW only — E-011). No CDO, no data catalog (E-061 confirms CTO scope is IT/InfoSec). Okta+Azure AD+DMARC/HSTS security stack (E-011). 2 cybersec board members (E-035).
